category_edits.rationale: Reduce tied item embedding width from 64 to 48 across all four datasets to test whether lower capacity improves generalization. Existing hidden_units plumbing resizes positional embeddings, prefix projection, normalization and convolution channels, saves the width in checkpoint metadata, and reconstructs matching predictor shapes. Preserve the six causal blocks, features, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer.
